title: Kind width bounded by the universal width
statement: Let $\kappa$ be a finite type, let $m,w\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $F$ assign to each $\kappa$-parameter a function from Boolean lists to Boolean lists. For every $\kappa_0\in\kappa$, the total size of the gadgets for the $w$ output coordinates of $F(\kappa_0,\cdot)$ is at most the maximum of those sizes over all parameters in $\kappa$.
